title: Seller Performance Standing: Step-Down Cap According to Record Tenure
content:
**Cap.** The step-down cap is the long-tenure step-down cap of 4 points for a standing record opened 1,095 days or more before the handling date, and the mid-tenure step-down cap of 3 points for a record opened at least 730 but fewer than 1,095 days before. For a record opened fewer than 730 days before, neither of these caps applies.

The tenure is the number of days from the opening of the seller's Seller Performance Standing record to the handling date. The step-down is limited to this cap or to the carried points, whichever is lower.

## Schedule

| Days from opening to the handling date | Step-down cap |
|---|---|
| 1,095 or more | 4 points |
| 730 to 1,094 | 3 points |
| fewer than 730 | neither cap above |

## Applying the limit (hypothetical)

| Points that step down before the limit | Carried points | Record opened, days before | Step-down |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 9 | 1,095 | 4 — held at the 4-point cap |
| 5 | 9 | 1,094 | 3 — held at the 3-point cap |
| 5 | 3 | 1,200 | 3 — held at the carried points, the lower |
| 2 | 9 | 730 | 2 — within the 3-point cap |
